parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures are from the Adjusted EBITDA* reconciliation table ($ in thousands). Summary slides show the same amounts in millions: $68.1 for Q2 2026 and $52.4 for Q2 2025. Period ends are assumed to be calendar quarter ends (June 30); Kadant's fiscal quarters may end on a nearby Saturday. Segment adjusted EBITDA (Flow Control, Industrial Processing, Material Handling) is excluded. No year-to-date figures are shown.
